operation: Product Opportunities v3.7 isolated Supabase test-project migration, platform canary, and full schema rollback

manifestEvidence.interpretation: The accepted manifest reuses a pinned previously audited Source Pin artifact. It does not claim that the Pin was successfully revalidated live during this retry.

liveAcquisitionAttempts.reason: The request returned HTTP 200 but the result object was not captured by the calling session, so no live-Pin PASS is claimed.
The source category was not in the reviewed launch taxonomy.
The merchant page returned HTTP 200 but did not prove a usable merchant-hosted product image.
The wedding-family candidate had no merchant-proven product type.
A bounded 301 www redirect ended at the same normalized PDP identity; the merchant page then proved the direct PDP, name and non-Pinterest image.

codeFindingsDuringLivePreparation.finding: The DNS public-address guard referenced ipaddress without importing it, causing a fail-closed NameError before merchant HTTP.
codeFindingsDuringLivePreparation.minimalRepair: Import the Python standard-library ipaddress module and add public/private resolution regression coverage.

codeFindingsDuringLivePreparation.finding: A valid www/non-www redirect chain was rejected when both URLs normalized to the same canonical PDP identity.
codeFindingsDuringLivePreparation.minimalRepair: Always validate bounded hop status, public URLs, continuity and final target; treat a same-identity chain as transport proof rather than identity-migration provenance.

independentReview.reason: Both Claude Opus read-only review attempts failed before analysis with HTTP 403 Request not allowed. This is an advisor authentication failure, not a code-review verdict and not a test failure.

scopeLimit: This PASS proves the isolated Supabase platform path for schema application, two-session concurrency, RLS/server-only write behavior, exact rollback and zero residue. Because the test project has no production legacy Product tables, it does not prove production legacy-integrity preservation, production deployment, production data quality, timer automation, or live Pinterest revalidation.
